subject.title: Field Report: 25 findings from 4 weeks of self-hosted production use (config crashes, CLI docs, Discord, cron)

question: Should maintainers keep this issue as a broad routing umbrella, or split the remaining current-main slices into focused canonical issues and then retire the umbrella?
rationale: The report spans config recovery policy, Discord/channel catch-up, cron ergonomics, onboard auth behavior, update process handling, and resource policy; source inspection cannot safely choose the tracking shape or product defaults.

options.title: Split and Retire Umbrella
options.body: Link the config startup slice to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85695, the missed-inbound slice to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/55792, open only focused current-main follow-ups for the remaining slices, then close this broad tracker.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave this issue open until every slice is fixed, rejected, or moved, accepting weaker automation signal because it spans several owners.

options.title: Close as Partially Superseded
options.body: Close now with links to the existing narrower work and ask reporters to file any slice that still reproduces on current main.

recommendation.title: Split and Retire Umbrella
recommendation.body: Link the config startup slice to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85695, the missed-inbound slice to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/55792, open only focused current-main follow-ups for the remaining slices, then close this broad tracker.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is primarily cross-surface product routing and config/channel policy, where the history and existing review discussion show the strongest adjacent decision signal.
